reason: My clients refuse portals and dump everything on WhatsApp, and expecting an article clerk to manually forward and tag every message into dockets is a daily habit that will break down within weeks. In a normal week without deadline panic, I will stick to our existing WhatsApp routine and at most test the free sandbox before paying for software.
objection: My clients will never use an intake portal—they just dump bills on WhatsApp, and forwarding messages manually creates extra overhead.
would_change_my_mind: A direct WhatsApp integration that automatically pulls client attachments and bank statements straight into Google Drive dockets without requiring staff to manually forward them.
